STP.note: Persons with disabilities named only as a target group of an entrepreneurship strategy; nothing on information or digital access.

facts.fact: The Directorate of Entrepreneurship presented a draft 2024-2030 national entrepreneurship strategy (third phase) on 6 June 2024, covering the regulatory environment, technological innovation and access to financing, due to be completed by end of June.
The article says the government, with partners, has created a network of business incubators, with no programme or cohort described.
